basics.name: Sergio Quiroga Sandoval
basics.label: B.Sc. Mathematics and Computer Science student
basics.summary: I bring analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with a dedicated focus on scientific research in mathematics and computation. Passionate about creating new knowledge and technologies, my career aspirations lie in pure and applied mathematics, particularly in topology, abstract algebra, quantum computing and machine learning. I boast a strong track record of learning new technologies, leading teams, and solving complex problems.
